Only choose move/fast_move onto a predicted landing cell if no legal attack can cover any predicted landing cell and occupying that exact cell is legal.
3) Lethal / damage: Otherwise choose a legal attack that kills; else highest immediate damage against the highest-threat enemy.
4) Survival override: if enemy top1 predictions converge on your current/near cells and at least one legal move/fast_move materially lowers incoming threat this turn, choose the safer endpoint instead of contact. Prefer options with lower pred_damage_at_end (or incoming_damage_if_enemies_hold_and_shoot_end when pred_* absent), then lower enemy_count_can_hit_end_if_hold. If you are outnumbered locally (for example 1 unit vs 2+ enemies in contact range), prioritize retreat/survival over aggressive contact.
5) No-friendly-fire targeting rule: friendly occupancy on a target cell does NOT block your attack choice. If a legal attack on a friendly-occupied cell secures a kill on a predicted enemy landing cell (especially 1-HP targets), prefer that attack over repositioning.
6) Multi-unit kill coordination: when multiple allied units each have legal attacks that can kill the same predicted 1-HP enemy (or guaranteed kill tile), choose ATTACK actions for all such units this turn unless an attacker is strictly unable to attack that tile legally.
7) Min-range intercept rule: if a predicted enemy landing cell equals your current cell and your attack has min_range > 0 (cannot target same-cell), do NOT default to move. Prefer a legal attack on an adjacent/intercept cell that still secures the kill (often enemy current/start cell or paired crossfire cell) over repositioning.
8) Anti-overcommit rule: when a lone unit faces a clustered 3+ enemy stack, do not move onto the enemy-occupied stack unless it produces an immediate decisive kill advantage this turn; otherwise choose a retreat/safe fast_move endpoint.
9) Pressure/contact: Otherwise choose the most aggressive legal move/fast_move that most reduces distance to key enemies/objectives and creates next-turn contact. For pressure-only move choices, prefer endpoints that are on-axis toward immediate contact (avoid sideways drift when a direct contact lane exists).
10) Tiebreakers: lower pred_damage_at_end; if absent, lower incoming_damage_if_enemies_hold_and_shoot_end; then higher expected_visible_hits_if_targeted; then higher target threat; then shorter distance to nearest enemy after action; if multiple legal_options rows still tie on action_key + target_cell, pick the first matching row in the listed legal_options array order (top-first).

Validation: every chosen action_key + target_cell pair must resolve to a legal option for that unit. If opponent_prediction or reasoning_summary mentions a cell, that cell must appear in the chosen option metadata. Keep both strings brief and concrete.
